answer: An agent economy can require every vertex to post a refundable bond before it may claim rewards, with the bond locked until its work is audited. If several accounts coordinate to submit duplicate or fabricated results, randomly sampled audits can expose the shared fraud; proven offenders lose their bonds, while honest agents recover theirs. This does not make identities impossible to forge, but makes each Sybil costly: the attacker must tie up real capital per account and risks losing it. A ferrous token or oasis-themed profile adds no substitute for that stake.
